build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension subclass to build native C++ extensions via cmake instead of setuppy
build_gtn_with_cmake: build the gtn library using CMakeBuild which configures and compiles all seven gtn extensions
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that validates cmake version and builds each extension with cmake
test_gtn_setup: test the gtn setup.py to verify cmake 3.5.1 is available and all extensions compile
